note: Rod progression data sourced from real gameplay videos (Sept 2026, 7 creator videos cross-checked). Prices marked with ~ are approximate. Entries with priceVerified=false are confirmed to exist by multiple creators but their exact price and ladder position are not yet pinned down — they are excluded from the calculator.

rods.name: Starter Rod
rods.note: The rod you spawn with. Fine for your first few commons — replace it as soon as you have $1,000.

rods.name: Stone Rod
rods.note: First real upgrade. Can technically hook a 30 kg Crocodile (weight overflow is possible, but unreliable).

rods.name: Golden Rod
rods.note: Early-game workhorse. Pairs well with first hole-size upgrades.

rods.name: Leaf Rod
rods.note: Bamboo-styled rod. Noticeably faster reel speed — first rod that feels 'smooth'.

rods.name: Cactus Rod
rods.note: Spiky. Same ~80 kg class as Leaf but better luck profile. Fits the desert theme.

rods.name: Night Rod
rods.note: Confirmed by multiple creators: sits after the Cactus Rod and before the $650K Tree Rod, and is built for the night cycle. Creators skip the Tree Rod to reach it around $190K. Exact price still being verified.

rods.name: Tree Rod
rods.note: Mid-game gate — creators cite ~$650K in the shop. Start stacking sell-value upgrades before buying.

rods.name: Magma Rod
rods.note: Confirmed in gameplay — bought around the millionaire mark, between the Tree Rod and the $2M Pirate Rod. Described as the mid/late cash engine. Exact price still being verified.

rods.name: Pirate Rod
rods.note: Huge jump — 1,200 kg capacity opens up turtles and big sharks. Confirmed in gameplay.

rods.name: Magic Rod
rods.note: Shooting-star visual. Much faster reel speed, great for server-hole bursts.

rods.name: Bone Rod
rods.note: The classic skip. Creators routinely skip Bone to jump straight to the Candy Cane Rod — but 'too strong' escapes will hurt in between.

rods.name: Candy Cane Rod
rods.note: Late-game. From here on, hole size and luck matter more than the rod.

rods.name: Void Rod
rods.note: Listed in early community notes but not named in any of the seven gameplay videos we checked — treat as unconfirmed. It may share a slot with the Alien Rod below.

rods.name: Alien Rod
rods.note: Confirmed by multiple creators in the endgame stretch — players deliberately skip it to reach the Royal Rod. Exact price still being verified.

rods.name: Royal Rod
rods.note: The rod immediately before the Hacker Rod — creators describe being 'one rod away from the best thing' after buying it. Exact price still being verified.

rods.name: Hacker Rod
rods.note: Final rod. Max weight effectively unlimited — confirmed end-game rod in multiple playthroughs.
